Open-source imaging and anatomy bridge

Use these external projects when a course needs real DICOM data or licensed mesh assets. External viewers open separately; do not upload protected health information unless your institution has approved the workflow.

OHIF Viewer ↗
Cornerstone local DICOM ↗
BodyParts3D source ↗
Z-Anatomy source ↗

OHIF and Cornerstone are MIT-licensed software. The current BodyParts3D archive license is CC BY 4.0. The headline Z-Anatomy license is CC BY-SA 4.0, but bundled upstream components can carry mixed and NonCommercial licenses, so every selected mesh needs an asset-level audit. No meshes from either collection are bundled here; attribution, file size, and structure-level provenance can be handled deliberately.
